title: Cow dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#4a3670'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <rect x='34' y='66' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <rect x='34' y='66' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#d8d8e4' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='57' y='64' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='33' y='82' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='82' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 52 Q82 48 80 58' stroke='#d8d8e4' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='59' r='4' fill='#c96a8a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#f8f8fc'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='50' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='56' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <!-- arms up dancing -->
  <path d='M30 42 Q18 34 16 26' stroke='#f8f8fc' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 42 Q82 34 84 26' stroke='#f8f8fc' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='24' r='4' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='24' r='4' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#f8f8fc'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='22' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#f4f4f8' transform='rotate(-25 33 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='22' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#f4f4f8' transform='rotate(25 67 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='22' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#e8a0b8' transform='rotate(-25 33 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='22' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#e8a0b8' transform='rotate(25 67 22)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M42 14 Q41 8 45 7' stroke='#e8d4a0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 14 Q59 8 55 7' stroke='#e8d4a0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#f0a8c0'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='32' rx='1.7' ry='2.2' fill='#b8607e'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='32' rx='1.7' ry='2.2' fill='#b8607e'/>
  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M45 36 Q50 40 55 36' stroke='#b8607e' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='23' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='23' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='43.9' cy='22.2' r='0.9' fill='#b0f0ff'/>
  <circle cx='57.9' cy='22.2' r='0.9' fill='#b0f0ff'/>
  <!-- sparkle of fun -->
  <path d='M78 14 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <path d='M20 40 l1 2 2 1 -2 1 -1 2 -1 -2 -2 -1 2 -1 z' fill='#ffe27a'/>
</svg>
